title: Halo
author: Charles Stross
note: conf=0.93; The EPUB's title/author metadata are swapped and garbled ("Charles Stross - Lobsters 04" / "Halo"). The work is "Halo," a novelette by Charles Stross, first published in Asimov's Science Fiction, June 2002, and a Hugo/Sturgeon nominee. ISFDB records it as Series: Macx Family, Series Number: 4 — the nine-story sequence (Lobsters, Troubadour, Tourist, Halo, Router, Nightfall, Curator, Elector, Survivor) later fixed up into the 2005 novel Accelerando. The filename's "Lobsters 04" is an informal fan-naming of the same sequence after its first installment; equivalent series names in use are "Accelerando" / "Macx Family." Not a standalone novel; the 2011 date is the ebook packaging date, not first publication.
